newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani rice prices seen steadier.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani rice prices seen steadier.

text.p: Pakistani rice export prices are likely to be steadier in the trading week starting Saturday amid weak demand from abroad, dealers said on Thursday.
"Rice export prices rose on fresh deals last week but demand has been dwindling and may pull prices down," one dealer said.
The dealer said export deals for superior quality Basmati variety were clinched in a range of $520 to $422 a tonne but now importers abroad were seeking lower rates.
In September rice exports fell to 74,748 tonnes worth $24 million, against 97,779 tonnes worth $31 million in August and 72,484 tonnes worth $27 million in September 1995.
